_note: Recorded working settings for the memory-first agent system (CLAUDE.md). Claude Code does NOT read this file; its real settings are in .claude/settings.json, which this does not change. Every value here is advisory and followed as an instruction unless marked enforced.

compaction.beforeCompaction: Run .claude/skills/session-memory-update first, so nothing important depends on the summary alone.
compaction.afterCompaction: Tell Rakesh that a compaction happened and what was kept.

worker.rule: lowest effort that still passes verification

modelRouting.note: The model and effort apply only when the agent is actually invoked as a subagent; the main session's model is set by the surface. Otherwise simulate the split in one session.
